group.title: An inventory-dashboard webinar
group.titleZh: 庫存儀表板線上說明會
group.passage: Hello, everyone, and welcome to this webinar on our updated inventory dashboard. Today's session focuses on setting stock alerts and exporting weekly summaries. The purchasing module will be covered in a separate session next month. You can enter questions in the chat at any time, and we will answer them after the demonstration. If the screen looks blurry, choose a higher video quality in your player settings; there is no need to restart the application. A recording and a practice data file will be emailed to registered participants tomorrow. Please use the sample data rather than uploading confidential company records.
group.passageZh: 大家好，歡迎參加新版庫存儀表板的線上說明會。今天著重在設定庫存警示，以及匯出每週摘要。採購模組會在下個月另一場說明會介紹。各位隨時可以在聊天室輸入問題，我們會在示範後回答。如果畫面模糊，請在播放器設定選擇較高畫質，不需要重新啟動應用程式。錄影和練習資料檔會在明天以電子郵件寄給已報名者。請使用範例資料，不要上傳公司的機密紀錄。

The purchasing module will be covered in a separate session next month. You can enter questions in the chat at any time, and we will answer them after the demonstration. If the screen looks blurry, choose a higher video quality in your player settings; there is no need to restart the application. A recording and a practice data file will be emailed to registered participants tomorrow. Please use the sample data rather than uploading confidential company records.

questions.prompt: What is the main focus of today's webinar?
questions.promptZh: 今天線上說明會的主要內容是什麼？

options.whyZh: 採購模組是下個月主題，且沒有說是合約議價。

options.zh: 庫存警示與每週摘要匯出。
options.whyZh: 主持人直接說 today's session focuses on 這兩項功能；採購模組延至下個月。
畫面模糊的提醒是播放器設定，不是硬體維修課。

options.text: Uploading company records to the dashboard.
options.zh: 將公司紀錄上傳至儀表板。
options.whyZh: 主持人要求使用範例資料，不要上傳公司紀錄；本場重點是庫存警示和匯出摘要。

questions.explanationZh: 主持人直接說 today's session focuses on 這兩項功能；採購模組延至下個月。

questions.prompt: When will participants' questions be answered?
questions.promptZh: 參加者的問題會在何時獲得回答？

options.whyZh: 下個月討論採購模組，當天問題會在示範後回答。

options.zh: 任何人進入說明會以前。
options.whyZh: 參加者在活動中提問，並非活動開始前已全部回答。
可隨時輸入問題，但回答時點是 after the demonstration；輸入與回答時間不同。

options.zh: 每次訊息出現時立刻回答。
options.whyZh: 主持人明確安排示範後集中回答，未承諾即時逐則回答。
